court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: II Family Court, Mannarkudi, HMOP No.27 of 2025
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2023. The respondent filed a petition under Section 13(1)(ia)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act before the Sub Court, Tambaram. The petitioner seeks to withdraw and transfer the proceedings to Neyveli due to hardship and to effectively contest the matrimonial proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Court ordinarily gives due weight to the convenience of the wife and the attendant circumstances.
legal_principles.held: particularly where the travel involved is long and repeated, and where connected proceedings are pending in the place where transfer is sought.

legal_principles.principle: The Court gives due weight to the hardship in undertaking long travel for every hearing.
legal_principles.held: the petitioner/wife is residing at Neyveli. She has placed before this Court the hardship in undertaking long travel for every hearing, and has also pointed out that proceedings under the Domestic Violence Act are pending at Neyveli, requiring her presence there.

outcome.final_order: The petition is allowed and the HMOP No.27 of 2025 is transferred from the file of the II Family Court, Mannarkudi to the Sub Court, Neyveli.
